description: Check the user's answer to one create_quiz question. Pass the question's ticket, the user's answer exactly as given (a letter, a name or a code), and the score_ticket from the previous check_answer, if there was one. Returns whether it was correct, the right answer, facts to share in the user's language, and the new score.

answer.description: The user's answer as given: an option letter, a name, or a code.

score_ticket.description: The score_ticket from the previous check_answer. Leave out for the first question.

ticket.description: The ticket of the question being answered.

name: check_answer

about.description: Facts to share. A population question has populations and source; the others have country facts.

correct_answer.description: The right answer in the quiz language.

game_over.description: True after the last life is lost.

play_url.description: A page on the site to play. Share it once.

score_ticket.description: Send this with the next check_answer.

title: Check a quiz answer
